pairs: quem cantavit Domino pro verbis Chusi,
which he sang to the Lord because of the words of Cush,
in te speravi; salvum me fac ex omnibus persequentibus me,
in you I have hoped. Save me from all those who persecute me,
nequando rapiat ut leo animam meam,
lest at any time, like a lion, he might seize my soul,
dum non est qui redimat, neque qui salvum faciat.
while there is no one to redeem me, nor any who can save.
si feci istud, si est iniquitas in manibus meis,
if there is iniquity in my hands, if I have done this:
if I have repaid those who rendered evils to me,
decidam merito ab inimicis meis inanis.
may I deservedly fall away empty before my enemies:
let the enemy pursue my soul,
et conculcet in terra vitam meam,
and trample my life into the earth,
et gloriam meam in pulverem deducat.
and drag down my glory into the dust. Pause
et exaltare in finibus inimicorum meorum:
And be exalted to the borders of my enemies.
according to the precept that you commanded,
and a congregation of people will surround you.
et propter hanc in altum regredere:
And, because of this, return on high.
et secundum innocentiam meam super me.
and according to my innocence within me.
The wickedness of sinners will be consumed,
and you will direct the just:
Just is my help from the Lord,
who saves the upright of heart.
How could he be angry throughout every day?
Et in eo paravit vasa mortis,
And with it, he has prepared instruments of death.
He has produced his arrows for those on fire.
Behold him who has given birth to injustice:
et incidit in foveam quam fecit.
And he has fallen into the hole that he made.
Convertetur dolor ejus in caput ejus,
His sorrow will be turned upon his own head,
et in verticem ipsius iniquitas ejus descendet.
and his iniquity will descend upon his highest point.
I will confess to the Lord according to his justice,
and I will sing a psalm to the name of the Lord Most High.
